latest.title: High-Dimensional Families of Minimal Surfaces of Arbitrary Genus in Round Spheres
latest.abstract: We prove the existence of arbitrarily high-dimensional families of minimal surfaces of any prescribed genus and conformal structure in even-dimensional round spheres. More precisely, let $n\geq2$ and let $Σ$ be any closed Riemann surface of genus $g$. We construct a sequence of degrees $d_\ell\to+\infty$ such that, for every $\ell$, there exists a complex manifold of complex dimension $2d_\ell+n^2(1-g)$ consisting of linearly full branched superminimal immersions of $Σ$ into $\mathbb S^{2n}$ of degree $d_\ell$. In particular, this yields parametrized families of linearly full branched minimal immersions whose dimensions tend to infinity.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 对任意给定 genus 与共形结构，在偶维圆球中构造维数任意大的分支超极小浸入族。
latest.breakthrough: 将存在性加强为给定共形类型的大参数族。
latest.limitations: 允许分支和浸入，不声称嵌入或无分支。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.priorityReason: 极小曲面构造及模空间相关度高。
